title: Fine Standing Reduction for Autopay Households of Long Tenure — Parking License
content:
Resident standing terms: a Parking License fine is reduced for a household whose Apartment Home Lease is enrolled in autopay and has been in possession for a long time, as shown by the lease's autopay enrollment and move-in date.

## Terms

When the lease the license belongs to is enrolled in autopay and its move-in date is at least 1461 days before the handling date, the fine standing reduction is $10.00; when that lease is enrolled in autopay and its move-in date is at least 365 but fewer than 1461 days before the handling date, the fine standing reduction is $5.00; in every other case there is no fine standing reduction. The fine standing reduction is subtracted from the scheduled fine, and the scheduled fine is never below zero.

## Truth table

| Apartment Home Lease enrolled in autopay | Days from move-in date to the handling date | Fine standing reduction |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 1461 or more | $10.00 |
| yes | 365 to 1460 | $5.00 |
| yes | fewer than 365 | none |
| no | any | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical leases enrolled in autopay)

- Move-in 1461 days before the handling date: $10.00; 1460 days: $5.00.
- Move-in 365 days before: $5.00; 364 days: none.

*Floor illustration (hypothetical):* a scheduled fine of $8.00 before this reduction, less a reduction of $10.00, stands at $0.00, never below zero.
